definitions.gloss: full (parking lot); no parking spaces available
definitions.explanation: Indicates that a parking lot has no available spaces. Commonly seen on signs at parking facilities.

examples.japanese: {駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}は{満車|まんしゃ}だ。
{満車|まんしゃ}だったので、{別|べつ}の{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}を{探|さが}した。
examples.english: It was full, so I looked for another parking lot.

examples.japanese: {休日|きゅうじつ}は{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}に{満車|まんしゃ}になることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: On holidays, the lot often fills up by the morning.

notes:
FORMATION:
{満|まん} (full) + {車|しゃ} (vehicle). Literally "full of cars."

USAGE:
Seen on electronic signs at parking garages and lots. The opposite is {空車|くうしゃ} (spaces available). Also used for taxis: {空車|くうしゃ} means available for hire, while {満車|まんしゃ} is not typically used for taxis (use {回送|かいそう} for off-duty).

CONTRAST:
- {満車|まんしゃ}: full, no spaces available
- {空車|くうしゃ}: spaces available (parking); available for hire (taxi)
- {満席|まんせき}: full seating (restaurants, theaters)
